Name: Younger Pam
Author: Ria
TagLine: A Pam redesign to make her a little younger and less grumpy-looking. Choose between long and short hair. Sprites included.
Description:
Made Pam look a little more like my personal headcanon of her. Has a couple of config options for hair length and saturation level of the character sprites so you can pick what matches your game better.  

A config will be created when you run your game once.  
The config options are **Long** or **Short** for PamHair and **Desat** or **Sat** for Recolor.  

Enjoy!  

Install  

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).  

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).  

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods
4.  [/font].  
Run the game using SMAPI.
